project_syncer.label: SYNCER
extended_desc: SYNCER is a Chrome extension that syncs playlists between Spotify and YouTube.
It parses each song, applies tokenization, fuzzy matching, and Levenshtein distance to find the best cross-platform match, and handles OAuth authentication via a FastAPI backend.

I built SYNCER for a few reasons; I wanted to keep my playlists updated on multiple platforms with little effort, I wanted to build and deploy a Chrome extension, and I wanted to learn how to use new technologies like FastAPI.
Thus, SYNCER was created!

project_lstm.label: LSTM Stock Predictor
extended_desc: A machine learning-driven tool that predicts stock prices using LSTM neural networks and backtests trading strategies with dynamic portfolio simulation.
I had always wanted to build something that utilized neural networks and applied to financial markets since I loved that intersection of ideas, and this was my first foray into it!
It will be constantly improved on and updated as I learn more about building neural networks, preprocessing data and synthesizing meaningful results from different implementations.

project_ss.label: Study Showdown
extended_desc: Study Showdown incentivizes staying on track with studying by tracking the sites each user visits in a given period.
Built for Hack the 6ix 2024, this Chrome Extension connects to a NextJS website to gamify productivity.
By staying on studying and productivity-based domains like KhanAcademy, you earn points, and by going on unproductive websites, you lose points.
At the end of each session, your points are calculated and ranked amongst other users on a global leaderboard!

project_recipelens.label: RecipeLens
project_recipelens.description: Flutter Mobile App - Best UI/UX Winner
extended_desc: RecipeLens is a mobile app designed to help users discover recipes based on available ingredients while accommodating dietary restrictions.

Whether you're a college student with limited ingredients, a parent figuring out meals for children, or a professional cook looking to sharpen skills, RecipeLens provides high-quality recipes in an accessible way.
The app won Best UI/UX at Ignition Hacks 2023, showcasing exceptional design and user experience despite being built by a team with no prior Flutter experience.
